notes: Fire safety: Full power now stays on until someone switches it off. The app turns it back on whenever the piano reports it off without that choice, so a preset (Soft, Cinematic, Expressive), a lower piano volume or a channel's volume no longer switch the piano to PWM drive, which can break the link to its power boards and leave a key on. Switching Full power off asks first, and stays off until someone switches it on again. Channel volume no longer lowers the piano while Full power is on.
